text:
alex_ml: bringing up maia9b-int4 on canary nodes. seeing OOM spikes under concurrent chat workloads and a small quality regression on our RG-100 evals after the int4 patch.
riley_infra: logs?
alex_ml: paste from one failing pod ->\n```\nOOM killed process pid=2345 mem=18.3G context=kv_prefetch
alloc failed at kv_cache.cpp:412
```\nthis happens when burst_concurrency >= 10 and max_new_tokens >= 128. single-request runs are fine.
zoe_research: what quant backend? we used asymmetric per-channel + fast-fp16 fallback for some layers.
sam_sre: sounds like fragmentation + prefetch sizing. did you enable `reserve_slots=true`? last rollout toggled that to false.
alex_ml: good catch — config currently: `reserve_slots:false`, `max_new_tokens:128`, `batch_size:8`, `max_batch_tokens:4096`, `kv_trim_ratio:0.12`.
riley_infra: try toggling `reserve_slots:true` and lower `batch_size` to 4. also set `max_batch_tokens` -> 2048 for canary to reduce per-batch allocations.
zoe_research: regen eval with `max_new_tokens=64` and compare. RG-100 shows ~1.8% regression at 128 on int4 vs fp16 but ~0.6% at 64. could be quant noise amplified by long tails.
nora_prod: SLA-wise we prefer predictable p95 latency even if token quality slightly lower. can we trade a bit of quality for fewer OOMs?
alex_ml: testing two variants now: A) reserve_slots:true + batch_size:4 + max_new_tokens:64; B) reserve_slots:false + kv_trim_ratio:0.25 + adaptive_prefetch:false. running 1k concurrent sim.
deploy-bot: canary deploy 2934012345-1 started by alex_ml at 2026-03-20T15:42:30Z :rocket:
sam_sre: fyi if OOMs persist, you can instrument `kv_alloc_hist` (prom metric) and `frag_ratio` to see fragmentation. if frag_ratio > 0.35 we should trigger compaction.
devex: doc note: default `max_new_tokens` for chat models changed last month from 128->96 for most 8-12B int4 models due to mem frag patterns. add that to the onboarding playbook.
alex_ml: quick results from A after 30m: no OOMs, p95 latency +12% but RG-100 loss delta ~+0.4%. B had 3 OOMs in 30m. A looks promising.
zoe_research: can you push eval artifacts to `s3://redwood-evals/maia9b/int4/2934012345-A/` and tag with `canary-0320`? I'll run cohort-specific checks.
alex_ml: done. next steps: promote A to broader canary, add automatic fallback to fp16 when frag_ratio spike detected, and update onboarding checklist to set `reserve_slots:true` by default for maia9b-int4.
riley_infra: also add a monitor alert: `sum(rate(kv_alloc_fail[5m])) > 0` -> page oncall; don't let it stay silent.
sam_sre: great. capture command used for reproducer in thread: `inference-cli --model maia9b-int4 --concurrency 12 --prompt-file ./rg_snippets.json --max-new-tokens 128 --batch-size 8`
alex_ml: saving that. thanks all :thumbsup:
